estimand: Fraction of reference-centred 500-m neighbourhoods whose retained historical habitat m is below their local 2000-2004 median connected capacity C0.

groups.all_valid: All score-valid 2025 centres; known mangrove absence retained.
groups.greener: m2025>0, finite annual and baseline EVI, annual EVI>baseline EVI.

geometric_reason: C=mq and 0<=q<=1 imply C<=m. At fixed current retention, even complete reconnection cannot reach C0 where m<C0.
deficit: max(C0-m2025,0); a dimensionless capacity gap. Percentage-point summaries multiply by 100.
interpretation: Additional occupancy of historical habitat is necessary to reach baseline connected capacity where m<C0. Reconnection feasibility also depends on the spatial arrangement of retained habitat.
statistics: Descriptive fractions weight centres equally and summarize spatially overlapping neighbourhoods.
missingness: Unknown observations remain missing in the source. Canopy groups require retained mangrove and finite EVI. Zero retention is a known state and is included only in the all-valid group.
